domain: Vacuum plus ten one-photon modes, with block-diagonal classical R/D memory; arbitrary complex optical density operators and all their matrix-unit coefficients
route_a: Use occupation-polynomial Fock lift columns from Gamma(W_k), and source Kraus transitions on occupations with fixed separate environment labels.
route_b: Use independently computed port-equation columns on vacuum plus ten modes, and tensor-factor local source four-state Kraus matrices on spectators.
comparison: Compare the complete unnormalized output operator at each prefix, not just its trace, on all E_ab within each classical memory block. These 242 matrix units are a complex basis, including non-Hermitian off-diagonal units.
composition: Equality of complex-linear outcome maps on a complete operator basis extends to arbitrary complex coefficients and commutes with every declared history prefix. No identification of distinct outcome/occurrence histories is implied.
boundary: The source's real nominal matrices still define complex-linear CP maps. The coefficient test covers imaginary Hermitian coherences by linear extension i(E_ab-E_ba), without interpreting non-Hermitian test units as physical states.
